development.household_effect: HYPOTHESISED and weak: the one housing project held has a rent capped by deed restriction, so a cheaper input would not reach a tenant as a lower rent

portfolio.state: NEITHER IS DEMONSTRATED. The shared-capacity gate is unmet: no capacity is known on either side.

two_perspectives.why_both: an intervention may raise regional productive capacity without producing an investable cash flow, and an enterprise may earn an attractive return while adding little regional capacity. Reporting one as the other is how development money gets spent on deals and investment money gets spent on programmes.

the_position: Two production networks, four activities, eight typed relationships. One accounting implication, and everything beyond it a hypothesis. The framework can now say what an activity requires and who it trades with; it still cannot say what anything costs here.
